title: feat(missions): import the open tickets as missions, and the owner moves missions from the Mission Center (MS-6, MS-5b, ADR-0044)

sourceMetadata.subject: feat(missions): import the open tickets as missions, and the owner moves missions from the Mission Center (MS-6, MS-5b, ADR-0044)
sourceMetadata.body:
Implements ADR-0044 Decision 7. There was no separate Mission Board: open work lived in ADR ticket lists and in the owner's conversations with Claude. A ticket counts as done when a commit names it; the open ones (BILL-1, the Executive Office's remaining preview parts, F-33) are recorded in runtime/executive/mission-imports with the reasons others were not imported (KO-3d done unnamed, KO-4a a note, parent tickets done through sub-tickets). scripts/import-missions.mjs creates each as a Planned mission in the owner's name, so importing decides nothing, and skips tickets already imported. MS-5 left owner-created missions with no way forward in the Executive Office; Mission Center cards now offer the lifecycle steps the state allows, with a reason where Runtime requires one, while Chief Agent proposals stay in the Approval Center. Mission Center presentation certified after owner visual approval.
